rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Only You Can Know
card.instruction: Treat one person as the only safe place for your honest reactions, while hiding how much their discretion determines what you can risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Close the office door. I hated the director's presentation. You're the only person I can say that to.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asked me to collect feedback.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put me down as engaged. This is just us having coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave your comments out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks. The standing ovation felt like a hostage video. More coffee?

card.title: Only You Can Know
card.instruction: Treat one person as the only safe place for your honest reactions, while hiding how much their discretion determines what you can risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're the only one who's read my notebook. I don't want to take over Dad's shop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He wants me to bring it to Sunday lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring the accounts notebook. This one's mostly spelling mistakes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep this one here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could I add something? I was relieved when the freezer broke. Terrible spelling on that page.

card.title: The Missing Truth
card.instruction: Treat every present exchange as incomplete until an old concealment, unanswered question, or broken confidence is finally addressed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before discussing the new holiday, why did you leave the old one early?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And every new itinerary still has that blank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we start fresh?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Answer the first question so it stops packing with us.

card.title: The Missing Truth
card.instruction: Treat every present exchange as incomplete until an old concealment, unanswered question, or broken confidence is finally addressed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll renew my club membership once you explain why my curtain vote vanished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're voting on curtains again. You can choose first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Where will you put my choice this time? Last year's blue never reached the minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll make you minute secretary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my first entry is 'Previous vote still unaccounted for.' Who can answer that?

card.title: Envious of the Lie
card.instruction: Treat another person’s composure under scrutiny as both impressive and unfair, resenting how easily they seem to control what others believe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You told the manager you hadn't lost the keys and he believed you instantly. How do you do that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hadn't lost them. I need you to tell him that too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With my face? You get innocence; I get follow-up questions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stand beside you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Could you look impressed when I tell the truth? Yours carries more weight.

card.title: Envious of the Lie
card.instruction: Treat another person’s composure under scrutiny as both impressive and unfair, resenting how easily they seem to control what others believe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your hands stayed still when the treasurer asked about the missing cash. Mine made me look guilty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put them in your pockets. We both need to finish these statements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You get believed naturally. I need special trousers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here, hold my statement. That'll keep them busy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even your paper looks innocent. Can mine go underneath it?

card.title: Before We Knew
card.instruction: Return emotionally to the time before a difficult truth changed what you could believe, trust, or say openly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you take Dad's fake trophy out of the cabinet, can I look at our photo?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You look so proud of him in it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was a lovely person to be. I thought he'd beaten twelve cyclists.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can keep the photo without displaying the trophy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could we put it by my bike? I started riding that afternoon.

card.title: Before We Knew
card.instruction: Return emotionally to the time before a difficult truth changed what you could believe, trust, or say openly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I preferred believing our club won honestly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't unknow the altered scores.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. But could we leave the bunting up until tea?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wouldn't that be pretending?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Briefly saying goodbye to the version I hung it for.

card.title: Everyone Knows Something
card.instruction: Interpret private conversations, careful wording, and unexplained pauses as signs that important information is being kept from you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why did everyone stop talking when I came into the staff kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'd finished choosing lunch. Do you want noodles?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is noodles what you're calling the thing I'm not supposed to know?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Look, here's the order. Yours is already on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You decided what I'd want before I arrived. How long have you been discussing me?

card.title: Everyone Knows Something
card.instruction: Interpret private conversations, careful wording, and unexplained pauses as signs that important information is being kept from you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Both notebooks closed when I sat down for the rota meeting. Am I being replaced?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine has my medical appointments in it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And does Jen keep your appointments too, or did you agree on that explanation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ask Jen about hers. You aren't reading mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So she's handling questions and you're guarding the records. When was that decided?

card.title: Protection Through Silence
card.instruction: Protect others by withholding details, redirecting questions, and managing timing because you trust your own judgment about when the truth should surface.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give you the whole letter once we've found a quiet place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And this doorway is a terrible place to receive it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can handle the news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Handling includes a chair, which I'm arranging.

card.title: Protection Through Silence
card.instruction: Protect others by withholding details, redirecting questions, and managing timing because you trust your own judgment about when the truth should surface.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give you the last page of the review after your concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does it say anything about my voice?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It says things you don't need to carry onto a stage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give it to me in the interval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's before your solo. I'll bring you water in the interval. Water hasn't formed an opinion.

card.title: Trusted with This
card.instruction: Treat being confided in as proof of closeness, and guard that privileged role whenever information begins spreading.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You told me about the move before your family. I thought that meant we were especially close.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We are. I'm telling them tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you call me just before? One last conversation where it's ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come to dinner. You can help me tell them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you say I already knew? I want to sit beside you, not among the surprised.

card.title: Trusted with This
card.instruction: Treat being confided in as proof of closeness, and guard that privileged role whenever information begins spreading.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why is there another chair in our private conversation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sam needs to know too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I just thought this part belonged to us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I trust both of you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you say my half before Sam arrives?

card.title: I Figured It Out
card.instruction: Create opportunities to reveal that you noticed the pattern first while pretending recognition matters less than solving the problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I circled the broken latch on Tuesday. Before it became everyone's theory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you say that facing the rest of the room?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought solving it mattered most.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Accuracy about who solved it is part of solving it.

card.title: I Figured It Out
card.instruction: Create opportunities to reveal that you noticed the pattern first while pretending recognition matters less than solving the problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my Tuesday note beside the leaking freezer. It identifies the overnight power cuts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. The engineer needs the times, not our names.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My initials distinguish observed times from later guesses. Purely useful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then write the repair request yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. 'Following my Tuesday discovery' gets the chronology settled before we trouble him with temperatures.

card.title: The Secrecy Protocol
card.instruction: Treat concealment as a precise ritual with passwords, signals, approved phrases, and severe consequences for careless improvisation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write the password before I hand over the surprise picnic sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're alone in the kitchen, and the bus leaves in two minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then write quickly. Speaking it cancels collection.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've written cucumber. That's yesterday's password, isn't it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've said it. The sandwiches stay here. I'll tell the walkers their lunch failed clearance.

card.title: The Secrecy Protocol
card.instruction: Treat concealment as a precise ritual with passwords, signals, approved phrases, and severe consequences for careless improvisation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before Mum comes in, signal where you've hidden her birthday cake. Cupboard is three fingers; fridge is four.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the table. I need to light the candles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Table is a flat palm. Say the location again and you lose candle duty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Flat palm. Can I have the matches?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After retraining. You must identify three concealed puddings without speech.

card.title: The Leak Is Spreading
card.instruction: Interpret every new question or coincidence as evidence that concealed information is escaping faster than it can be contained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The florist asked what time our surprise party starts. How did it get out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told her so she'd deliver before Dad arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now the driver knows. Can you collect the flowers yourself?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I'll ask the baker to give me a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's reached the baker while we were containing the florist. How many stops is this lift making?

card.title: The Leak Is Spreading
card.instruction: Interpret every new question or coincidence as evidence that concealed information is escaping faster than it can be contained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why are there three copies of our private resignation letter on your desk?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One for each of us and a spare. Nobody else has seen it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The spare is a conversation waiting to happen. Shred it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I use the accounts shredder? Ours is jammed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Accounts already? We haven't destroyed one copy and it's reached another department. Who there knows?

transfer.action: I move {prop} to your chair and close the nearby door.
transfer.opening: Only you get the rest of this sentence. {request}
transfer.response: I need to know these words stop with you. {counter}
transfer.closing: I can tell them the weather. This needs your particular quiet.

transfer.action: I place the unanswered old question beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Everything new still runs into this blank. {request}
transfer.response: We can't call it settled while that line stays empty. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'd like to. The old question keeps introducing itself first.

transfer.action: I copy your composed hands while looking at {prop}.
transfer.opening: Must be nice to look that innocent. {request}
transfer.response: I can make a story sound effortless too. {counter}
transfer.closing: A remarkable advantage. Some of us have to practise the appearance.

transfer.action: I turn the old photograph away from {prop}.
transfer.opening: I liked the world before we found this out. {request}
transfer.response: Give the old explanation one minute before replacing it. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then let me say goodbye to the version that made the photograph easier.

transfer.action: I pull a chair up to the closed notes about {prop}.
transfer.opening: I seem to have missed the part everyone knows. {request}
transfer.response: The sentence stopped exactly when I arrived. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then why do all the notebooks close before mine opens?

transfer.action: I put a gentle summary over the last page beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Timing is part of telling the truth. {request}
transfer.response: Let's choose somewhere soft to hear the rest. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'd like it to reach you somewhere kinder than this doorway.

transfer.action: I hold the private message beside {prop} close to my chest.
transfer.opening: You told me first. I'd like that to matter. {request}
transfer.response: Is this still a just-us conversation? {counter}
transfer.closing: Tell me before the circle gets wider without me.

transfer.action: I set my dated prediction visibly beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I circled it on Tuesday. Merely for accuracy. {request}
transfer.response: You might notice whose pencil reached that idea first. {counter}
transfer.closing: Only the credit that would naturally arise from reading the dates.

transfer.action: I tap three times before indicating {prop}.
transfer.opening: Password first. Then the ordinary conversation. {request}
transfer.response: Use the approved gesture rather than the name. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then keeping the lunch password should be wonderfully manageable.

transfer.action: I count the copies circulating around {prop}.
transfer.opening: How did that question reach this room already? {request}
transfer.response: Every copy means another conversation I haven't located. {counter}
transfer.closing: It travelled into your sentence while I was counting.
